Your holdings: SOXL (-41.79%) and SPAL (-28.95%) are still marked SELL. They are leveraged and decaying, and these losses are amplified by margin. CRWD (+38.56%) and QQQ (+4.31%) are holding up.

Watch: Keep an eye on Nvidia (headline 5) as options activity is unusual ahead of catalysts.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged, losing positions and watching for clear signals in key tech names.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or stopping out if it breaks below its current price, given the leverage and decay.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate trimming or stopping out if the price deteriorates further.
